cal: Prime window is roughly early-to-mid July, when the bergschrund crossing is straightforward and the upper scramble is mostly snow-free. Plan around the Lady of the Lake ferry and Holden shuttle schedule, and budget a 4th day if you want a more relaxed pace or want to add Martin Peak.

days.note: Ferry from Chelan/Field's Point to Lucerne, bus to Holden Village, then about 6 miles and 3,800 ft up the Holden Lake trail to a camp at Holden Lake or, for a shorter summit day, higher at Holden Pass.
days.title: Ferry, bus, and hike to high camp
days.objective: Reach a camp at Holden Lake or Holden Pass

days.note: Leave camp pre-dawn, top Holden Pass within the hour, then rope up and cross the Mary Green Glacier to the upper gully/bergschrund. A short section of Class 3-4 rock and scrambling leads to the summit; the round trip runs about 8-9 hours including roughly four rappels on the way down.
days.title: Climb the Mary Green Glacier to the summit

schedule.label: Leave camp
schedule.detail: Early start to catch firm snow and beat afternoon heat.

schedule.label: Onto the Mary Green Glacier
schedule.detail: Rope up, crampons on for the glacier crossing.

schedule.label: Bergschrund / upper gully
schedule.detail: Transition off the glacier onto Class 3-4 rock.

schedule.label: Back at camp
schedule.detail: About four rappels plus down-climbing on the descent.

days.objective: Reach the summit via the standard glacier route and return to camp

days.note: Pack up camp, hike back down to Holden Village, and catch the shuttle/ferry back to Lucerne and Chelan (some parties overnight at Holden's Ballpark campground and take an early bus the next morning if the ferry timing doesn't line up).
days.title: Hike out and catch the ferry
days.objective: Return to Holden and connect with the bus/ferry

totalNote: The classic 3-day Bonanza itinerary: hike in to a Holden Lake/Holden Pass camp, spend an 8-9 hour, ~5,000 ft round-trip day climbing the glacier to the summit, and hike out the next day (add a 4th day for a more relaxed pace or to also climb Martin Peak).
